title: Four-Cell Ports and Composable Highway Scattering for Langton’s Ant
description: A sharp four-cell one-sided highway interface and an exact 918-update three-cell exit bound yield four-cell exterior completion after any finite observation. Protected scattering interfaces compose into arbitrary finite trains, including unbounded return excursions with old-wake readback and the complete field retained. These resource thresholds and full-field closure theorems extend the classical ant's earlier finite-gadget constructions.
